title: Atlantic Fellows for Social and Economic Equity
institution: London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), International Inequalities Institute
about: LSE's Atlantic Fellows for Social and Economic Equity programme is recruiting its 2027-28 cohort of practitioners with at least seven years' experience working on inequality. Applications close 11 January 2027 at 5pm UK time; late applications are not accepted.
requirements: Must meet LSE's English language requirements
Residential-track applicants must also qualify for the MSc in Inequalities and Social Science
Apply through LSE's Graduate Application System; incomplete applications are not considered
card_alt: Card for the Atlantic Fellows for Social and Economic Equity at the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), International Inequalities Institute, London, United Kingdom. Deadline 11 Jan 2027.
